The Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed LED Recessed Downlight delivers efficient, dimmable illumination, ideal for contemporary spaces. This fire-rated luminaire, with a stylish satin nickel bezel, provides reliable performance in various indoor settings; its IP65 rating makes it perfect for bathrooms and kitchens. The integrated LED emits warm white 3000K light with a 65-degree beam angle, suitable for creating a comfortable atmosphere in commercial and domestic projects. Installation is quick and straightforward for electricians and installers, using a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block and a standard 57mm cut-out. A durable steel body ensures a long 50,000-hour lifespan.
